cat > /root/turn_residual_gating/scripts/d048_llama_pcgrad.sh << 'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# D048 Llama-3.1-8B PCGrad training (seed=42)
# PCGrad resolves NTP-GAR gradient conflict on gate params
# Deps: phase2_llama_tg_s42 must exist (same arch, different optimizer)
# Est. time: ~3h on single A6000/A100
set -e
cd /root/turn_residual_gating
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B-Instruct/
OUT_DIR=runs/phase2_llama_pcgrad_s42

PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python src/train_phase2_v9_pcgrad.py \
  --model "$MODEL" \
  --gate-type threadgate \
  --gar-loss-mode mse_target --gar-target 0.5 \
  --lambda-gar 1.0 --lambda-gate-div 1.0 \
  --min-gate-std 0.05 --init-bias 1.5 \
  --gate-lr-multiplier 10 \
  --lr 2e-4 --batch-size 1 --grad-accum 8 \
  --max-seq-len 2048 \
  --seed 42 --epochs 3 \
  --output-dir "$OUT_DIR" \
  --data-dir data/ultrachat_8k \
  2>&1 | tee "${OUT_DIR}.log"
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/turn_residual_gating/scripts/d048_llama_pcgrad.sh

cat > /root/turn_residual_gating/scripts/d048_llama_ug.sh << 'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# D048 Llama-3.1-8B Uniform Gate training (seed=42)
# Ablation: gate fixed to uniform (no learned per-layer adaptation)
# Est. time: ~2.5h on single A6000/A100
set -e
cd /root/turn_residual_gating
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B-Instruct/
OUT_DIR=runs/phase2_llama_ug_s42

PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python src/train_phase2.py \
  --model "$MODEL" \
  --gate-type uniform \
  --gar-loss-mode mse_target --gar-target 0.5 \
  --lambda-gar 1.0 --lambda-gate-div 1.0 \
  --min-gate-std 0.05 --init-bias 1.5 \
  --gate-lr-multiplier 10 \
  --lr 2e-4 --batch-size 1 --grad-accum 8 \
  --max-seq-len 2048 \
  --seed 42 --epochs 3 \
  --output-dir "$OUT_DIR" \
  --data-dir data/ultrachat_8k \
  2>&1 | tee "${OUT_DIR}.log"
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/turn_residual_gating/scripts/d048_llama_ug.sh

cat > /root/turn_residual_gating/scripts/d048_llama_eval_all.sh << 'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# D048 Llama 5-way eval: Base / TG / UG / LO / PCGrad
# Part 1: TF eval (eval_phase2_gar.py, ours+dongre)
# Part 2: AR eval (eval_attention_steering.py --mode gen, N=50)
# Part 3: Bootstrap CI on GAR curves (curve[2:])
# Est. time: ~2-3h total (5 conditions × 2 variants × 2 modes)
set +e

cd /root/turn_residual_gating
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

# ── Paths ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
PYTHON=/root/miniconda3/bin/python3.12
TF_EVAL=src/eval_phase2_gar.py
AR_EVAL=src/eval_attention_steering.py
MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B-Instruct/
TF_CONV=data/ultrachat_eval_sample.json
AR_DATA=data/eval_200/eval_200.json
OUT_ROOT=results/d048_llama_eval
AR_MAX_CONVS=50

# ── Checkpoints ────────────────────────────────────────────
TG_CKPT=runs/phase2_llama_tg_s42/epoch_2
LO_CKPT=runs/phase2_llama_lora_only_s42/epoch_2
UG_CKPT=runs/phase2_llama_ug_s42/epoch_2
PC_CKPT=runs/phase2_llama_pcgrad_s42/epoch_2

mkdir -p "$OUT_ROOT"

# ── Checkpoint validation ──────────────────────────────────
echo "=== Checkpoint validation ==="
MISSING=0
for ckpt_label_dir in "TG:$TG_CKPT" "LO:$LO_CKPT" "UG:$UG_CKPT" "PCGrad:$PC_CKPT"; do
    label="${ckpt_label_dir%%:*}"
    dir="${ckpt_label_dir#*:}"
    if [ -d "$dir/lora" ]; then
        echo "  $label: OK ($dir)"
    else
        echo "  $label: MISSING ($dir)"
        MISSING=1
    fi
done
if [ "$MISSING" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "WARNING: Some checkpoints missing. Will skip those conditions."
fi
echo ""

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Part 1: Teacher-Forced GAR (eval_phase2_gar.py)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

run_tf() {
    local label=$1 gate_type=$2 ckpt=$3 variant=$4
    local outdir="$OUT_ROOT/tf_${label}_${variant}"
    local ckpt_arg=""
    if [ -n "$ckpt" ]; then
        ckpt_arg="--checkpoint-dir $ckpt"
    fi
    echo "========== [TF] ${label} + ${variant} =========="
    $PYTHON $TF_EVAL \
      --model "$MODEL" \
      --gate-type "$gate_type" \
      $ckpt_arg \
      --conversations-path "$TF_CONV" \
      --output-dir "$outdir" \
      --gar-variant "$variant" \
      --gate-profile
}

# Base
run_tf base none "" ours
run_tf base none "" dongre

# TG
if [ -d "$TG_CKPT/lora" ]; then
    run_tf tg threadgate "$TG_CKPT" ours
    run_tf tg threadgate "$TG_CKPT" dongre
fi

# UG
if [ -d "$UG_CKPT/lora" ]; then
    run_tf ug uniform "$UG_CKPT" ours
    run_tf ug uniform "$UG_CKPT" dongre
fi

# LO
if [ -d "$LO_CKPT/lora" ]; then
    run_tf lo none "$LO_CKPT" ours
    run_tf lo none "$LO_CKPT" dongre
fi

# PCGrad
if [ -d "$PC_CKPT/lora" ]; then
    run_tf pcgrad threadgate "$PC_CKPT" ours
    run_tf pcgrad threadgate "$PC_CKPT" dongre
fi

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Part 2: AR eval (eval_attention_steering.py --mode gen)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

run_ar() {
    local label=$1 gate_type=$2 ckpt=$3 variant=$4
    local outdir="$OUT_ROOT/ar_${label}_${variant}"
    local ckpt_arg=""
    if [ -n "$ckpt" ]; then
        ckpt_arg="--checkpoint $ckpt"
    fi
    echo "========== [AR] ${label} + ${variant} =========="
    $PYTHON $AR_EVAL \
      --model "$MODEL" \
      --gate-type "$gate_type" \
      $ckpt_arg \
      --mode gen \
      --data-file "$AR_DATA" \
      --max-convs $AR_MAX_CONVS \
      --gar-variant "$variant" \
      --output-dir "$outdir"
}

# Base
run_ar base none "" ours
run_ar base none "" dongre

# TG
if [ -d "$TG_CKPT/lora" ]; then
    run_ar tg threadgate "$TG_CKPT" ours
    run_ar tg threadgate "$TG_CKPT" dongre
fi

# UG
if [ -d "$UG_CKPT/lora" ]; then
    run_ar ug uniform "$UG_CKPT" ours
    run_ar ug uniform "$UG_CKPT" dongre
fi

# LO
if [ -d "$LO_CKPT/lora" ]; then
    run_ar lo none "$LO_CKPT" ours
    run_ar lo none "$LO_CKPT" dongre
fi

# PCGrad
if [ -d "$PC_CKPT/lora" ]; then
    run_ar pcgrad threadgate "$PC_CKPT" ours
    run_ar pcgrad threadgate "$PC_CKPT" dongre
fi

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Part 3: Bootstrap CI (curve[2:])
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

echo ""
echo "========== Bootstrap CI =========="

$PYTHON -c "
import json, glob, os, numpy as np

out_root = '$OUT_ROOT'
conditions = ['base', 'tg', 'ug', 'lo', 'pcgrad']
modes = ['tf', 'ar']
np.random.seed(42)
N_BOOT = 1000

results = {}
for mode in modes:
    for cond in conditions:
        path = os.path.join(out_root, f'{mode}_{cond}_ours')
        gar_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(path, '*_gar.json'))
        if not gar_files:
            continue
        with open(gar_files[0]) as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        curve = data.get('gar_curve', data.get('per_turn_gar', []))
        if len(curve) < 3:
            continue
        vals = np.array(curve[2:])
        boot_means = [np.mean(vals[np.random.randint(0, len(vals), len(vals))]) for _ in range(N_BOOT)]
        ci_lo, ci_hi = np.percentile(boot_means, [2.5, 97.5])
        mean_val = np.mean(vals)
        key = f'{mode}_{cond}'
        results[key] = {'mean': float(mean_val), 'ci_lo': float(ci_lo), 'ci_hi': float(ci_hi), 'n_turns': len(vals)}
        print(f'  {key:20s}  GAR={mean_val:.4f}  95%CI=[{ci_lo:.4f}, {ci_hi:.4f}]  (n={len(vals)} turns)')

with open(os.path.join(out_root, 'bootstrap_ci.json'), 'w') as f:
    json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
print(f'\nSaved to {out_root}/bootstrap_ci.json')
"

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Summary
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
echo ""
echo "================================================================"
echo "D048 Llama 5-way eval complete"
echo "================================================================"
echo "Conditions: Base / TG / UG / LO / PCGrad"
echo "TF results: $OUT_ROOT/tf_*/"
echo "AR results: $OUT_ROOT/ar_*/"
echo "Bootstrap:  $OUT_ROOT/bootstrap_ci.json"
echo ""
echo "Key comparisons:"
echo "  TG vs Base:     tf_tg_ours vs tf_base_ours"
echo "  UG vs TG:       tf_ug_ours vs tf_tg_ours  (gate adaptation value)"
echo "  LO vs TG:       tf_lo_ours vs tf_tg_ours  (gate contribution)"
echo "  PCGrad vs TG:   tf_pcgrad_ours vs tf_tg_ours  (PCGrad vs naive)"
echo "  TF-AR gap:      tf_*_ours vs ar_*_ours"
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/turn_residual_gating/scripts/d048_llama_eval_all.sh

cd /root/turn_residual_gating && bash -n scripts/d048_llama_pcgrad.sh && echo "pcgrad: OK" && bash -n scripts/d048_llama_ug.sh && echo "ug: OK" && bash -n scripts/d048_llama_eval_all.sh && echo "eval: OK"

### 产出

| 脚本 | 路径 | 训练命令 | 预估时间 |
|------|------|---------|---------|
| **PCGrad** | `scripts/d048_llama_pcgrad.sh` | `train_phase2_v9_pcgrad.py` + Llama + threadgate | ~3h |
| **UG** | `scripts/d048_llama_ug.sh` | `train_phase2.py` + Llama + `--gate-type uniform` | ~2.5h |
| **5-way Eval** | `scripts/d048_llama_eval_all.sh` | TF(`eval_phase2_gar.py`) + AR(`eval_attention_steering.py --mode gen`) + Bootstrap CI | ~2-3h |

### 超参统一（D048 协议）
- lr=2e-4, batch_size=1, grad_accum=8, max_seq_len=2048, epochs=3, seed=42
- gar-target=0.5, init-bias=1.5, gate-lr-multiplier=10（与现有 Llama TG/LO 一致）

### Checkpoint 路径
- TG: `runs/phase2_llama_tg_s42/epoch_2` ✓ 存在
- LO: `runs/phase2_llama_lora_only_s42/epoch_2` ✓ 存在
- UG: `runs/phase2_llama_ug_s42/epoch_2` — 训练后生成
- PCGrad: `runs/phase2_llama_pcgrad_s42/epoch_2` — 训练后生成

### Eval 脚本特点
- `set +e` 避免单个条件失败中断全部
- 自动跳过缺失 checkpoint 的条件（先训完 UG/PCGrad 再跑 eval）
- Bootstrap CI 取 `curve[2:]`，1000 次重采样，输出到 `results/d048_llama_eval/bootstrap_ci.json`
